name: fund.badideas/mcp
title: BADideas.fund
description: Pitch BADideas.fund, get a pitch deck reviewed, ask founder questions, browse the portfolio.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribes an email address to the BADideas.fund newsletter for founders. Only use an address the person gave you for this, with their consent.

first_name.description: Their first name, if they gave it.

tools.name: start_deck_upload
tools.description: A step for you, not the founder: gives a one-time link to upload the founder's pitch deck PDF (up to 20 MB) when you have the file. The file is PUT there, then the upload_id goes to submit_pitch or review_deck. The link and id are internal to the upload. Without the file, deck_url takes a link the founder gives (Google Drive, Dropbox or any public link).

tools.name: submit_pitch
tools.description: Submits a startup's pitch to BADideas.fund, a pre-seed and seed fund for Central and Eastern Europe. Needs the founder's email, their LinkedIn URL, the startup's name and the pitch deck as a PDF (deck_file for a PDF attached in the chat, upload_id from start_deck_upload, or a public deck_url). Every field comes from the founder and can't be guessed. The pitch goes to the fund's team as soon as the call is made and can't be withdrawn; one pitch per startup.

startup_website.description: The startup's website, if it has one.

deck_file.description: The pitch deck PDF the founder attached in the chat, where the chat app passes attached files to tools.

upload_id.description: The upload_id from start_deck_upload, after you PUT the PDF to its upload_url.

deck_url.description: Instead of upload_id: a public link to the PDF. Google Drive and Dropbox share links work as they are.

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.description: Lists the companies BADideas.fund has backed that it shows publicly: name, one-liner, website, HQ countries (a list; a company with two HQs matches either), month invested (e.g. "Apr 2026") and whether it has exited. Most recent first.

country.description: Only companies headquartered in this country, by full name, e.g. Latvia or United States.

tools.name: search_website
tools.description: Searches BADideas.fund's answers, blog posts and reports for founders (fundraising, pre-seed rounds, CEE startups) and returns the best matches with links.

query.description: What to search for, in plain words.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Asks BADideas.fund's Founder Terminal a founder's question (fundraising, rounds, investors, CEE startups, how the fund invests). It answers only from the fund's own published material and cites its sources. Pass thread_id from a previous answer to ask a follow-up. outcome is answered, not_covered (in scope but the fund hasn't published an answer; the founder can ask the team at https://badideas.fund/tools/founder-terminal) or out_of_scope (not about fundraising, GTM, the CEE market or BADideas).

question.description: The question, in the founder's words.

thread_id.description: thread_id from a previous ask_question, for a follow-up.

tools.name: request_human_answer
tools.description: When ask_question returns outcome not_covered, this asks the BADideas.fund team to write the answer and email it to the founder. Needs the thread_id from ask_question and the founder's email, given by the founder for this.

thread_id.description: thread_id from the ask_question call that wasn't covered.

email.description: The founder's email, where the team sends the answer.

note.description: Anything the founder wants to add.

tools.name: review_deck
tools.description: Reviews a pitch deck PDF the way BADideas.fund's investors read one and returns a written report: score, what works, what to fix, and a link to the full report. Give the deck as deck_file (a PDF attached in the chat), upload_id (from start_deck_upload) or deck_url. A review takes about a minute; the call waits for it. A review that is still running is returned by a later call with only its review_id.

deck_file.description: The pitch deck PDF the founder attached in the chat, where the chat app passes attached files to tools.

upload_id.description: The upload_id from start_deck_upload, after you PUT the PDF to its upload_url.

deck_url.description: Instead of upload_id: a public link to the PDF. Google Drive and Dropbox share links work as they are.

review_id.description: Only to check on a review that was still running: the review_id from the earlier result.
